caption: The core keeps one route, 10.0.0.0/22, covering 10.0.0.0 to 10.0.3.255, which is 1024 addresses, instead of four /24 routes. A packet to 10.0.2.5 matches the summary and the /24 as well; the longer /24 prefix wins.

spec.aria: One summary route 10.0.0.0/22 at the core covers four /24 networks, 10.0.0.0 to 10.0.3.0, in two areas; a packet to 10.0.2.5 matches both the summary and the /24, and the /24 with 24 prefix bits wins by longest prefix match.
